intro: Switzerland has four national languages, and about a quarter of the people living there are foreign citizens.

chapters.title: Four languages
text: Most Swiss speak German, usually a Swiss German dialect, while French is spoken in the west, Italian in the south and Romansh by a small number in the canton of Graubünden. Many Swiss speak several languages.
Zürich is the largest city, and Geneva, Basel, Lausanne and Bern, the federal city, are other important centres.

chapters.title: Swiss life
text: The Swiss are known for punctual trains, strict recycling rules and military service for men. Switzerland has enough nuclear bunkers to shelter its whole population.

keyTerms.meaning: A Romance language spoken in eastern Switzerland.
